sourceFacts.fact: The first breaths and lung expansion contribute to pulmonary vasodilation.
Rising oxygen also contributes to the fall in pulmonary vascular resistance.
Lower pulmonary vascular resistance permits increased pulmonary blood flow after birth.

edges.meaning: lower resistance supports increased blood flow

labels: Birth lowers resistance to pulmonary flow
forbiddenAnatomy: Organs, heart chambers, named-vessel topology, vascular/cardiac cutaways, clinical photos

checks: Gate opening represents pulmonary vascular resistance falling; flow tokens are blood not inhaled air.
